rows.note: Use 協議 as the all-purpose noun for an arrangement that parties have agreed to follow.

example.english: We have signed an agreement to work together.
example.traditional: 我哋已經簽咗協議，會一齊合作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 cim1 zo2 hip3 ji5 wui5 jat1 cai4 hap6 zok3

rows.note: Use 共識 when several people or parties share the same view or opinion.

example.english: After talking it over, we finally reached an agreement.
example.traditional: 大家傾完之後，終於有共識。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 king1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gung6 sik1

rows.note: Use 合約 specifically for a legally binding contract or agreement.

example.english: This agreement states that tenants may not sublet.
example.traditional: 呢份合約寫明租客唔可以轉租。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 hap6 joek3 se2 ming4 zou1 haak3 m4 ho2 ji5 zyun2 zou1
